vehicle_state: independent position, remaining capacity, available time per vehicle
cost_definition: sum of committed customer and depot edges with start < boundary plus terminal physical closure; unstarted planned suffixes are not charged
tabu_implementation: standalone deterministic Python tabu search with swap, relocate, and 2-opt neighbourhoods; it does not call OR-Tools

timing_definition.online_replanning_time: sum of planner calls at t>0, including the terminal closure
timing_definition.total_elapsed_time: end-to-end environment plus all planning calls per instance
timing_definition.time_100_aggregation: sum of the 100 per-instance elapsed times, independent of parallel experiment wall time
